SKILL.md is a UTF-8 Markdown roleplay guide with Chinese and English prose. I found no binary payload, encrypted data, or obfuscated executable content.

content.value_statement: Roleplay sessions about alien ecology need structure, risk, and scientific detail. This skill gives Claude, Codex, or Claude Code a staged Stella Chen plant research chapter.
actual_capabilities: Sets a Stella Chen research scene on days five to seven after a crash.
Offers player choices for glowing plants, giant trees, fruits, and ground plants.
Provides dialogue for glowing plant research and strange fruit analysis.
Introduces hazards through a carnivorous plant or accidental poisoning scene.
Turns discoveries into useful resources like lighting, insulation, rope, and antibacterial sap.
Supports three endings that emphasize research success, learned caution, or mystery.
limitations: This is narrative guidance, not real botany or survival advice.
Detailed sample dialogue is stronger for glowing plants and fruit than for every choice.
The source uses mixed Chinese and English by design.
It includes no executable code, art assets, or external data sources.

use_cases.title: Run a Science Fiction Roleplay Chapter
use_cases.description: Use the staged scenes to guide a player through alien plant research and risky choices.

use_cases.title: Develop Stella Chen Character Moments
use_cases.description: Show Stella moving from survival mode into careful scientific curiosity and problem solving.

use_cases.title: Prototype Alien Ecology Scenes
use_cases.description: Create plant behaviors, hazards, and resources for a larger survival setting.

prompt_templates.title: Start the Research Day
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the studying-alien-flora skill. Start Stella Chen on day five near camp. Offer four plant study choices and wait for my choice.

prompt_templates.title: Play the Glowing Plant Branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the glowing plant branch. Describe careful sampling, microscopic findings, and a small practical energy discovery. Keep Stella cautious and excited.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Controlled Hazard
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the chapter with one plant hazard. Make the danger clear, let Stella analyze it, and end with a useful lesson.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the Chapter to a Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill as a base. Connect the plant research to my campaign lore, one practical resource, and one mystery for a later chapter.

output_examples.input: Start the chapter and let me choose what Stella studies first.
output_examples.output: Stella checks her sample kit, microscope, and analyzer. She asks whether to study glowing plants, giant trees, fruit, or ground plants.

output_examples.input: I choose the strange fruit, but I want Stella to be careful.
output_examples.output: Stella scans several fruit samples, compares unknown compounds, and recommends skin testing or juice analysis before any tasting.

output_examples.input: End with a useful discovery after the danger scene.
output_examples.output: After marking the hazardous plant area, Stella identifies thermal moss, strong vines, and antibacterial sap as practical camp resources.

best_practices: Keep Stella scientific, curious, and cautious in every risky scene.
Ask the player to choose between clear research options before advancing.
Connect each danger to a lesson, resource, or future story clue.
anti_patterns: Do not present alien plant tasting as real safety advice.
Do not skip player choice and turn the chapter into fixed narration.
Do not make every plant harmless, because risk supports the chapter theme.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an interactive alien botany chapter for Stella Chen on Gaia.

faq.question: Can it be used with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?

faq.question: How should I continue after the chapter?
faq.answer: Use the suggested follow-ups for cooking, daily science, ruins, or alien encounters.
